auth.accounts.subtitle.source: Accounts signed in on this browser

auth.authorize.choose_account.source: Choose the account to sign in to

auth.authorize.incomplete.source: This sign-in link is incomplete. Please start again from the application.

auth.authorize.unknown_client.text: 此登录链接对应的应用不在本部署的已知应用之列。

auth.consent.all_required.source: All confirmations are required to continue.
auth.consent.all_required.text: 需要勾选全部确认项才能继续。

auth.consent.all_required.text: 需要勾选全部四项确认才能继续。

auth.consent.intro.source: Please read the terms and confirm each item below.
auth.consent.intro.text: 请阅读条款，并逐项确认以下内容。

auth.consent.intro.source: {app_name} is an experimental research service. Please read and confirm each item below.
auth.consent.intro.text: {app_name} 是一项实验性研究服务。请阅读并逐项确认以下内容。

auth.consent.terms_body.source: Please read the terms in full. The confirmations below unlock once you reach the end.
auth.consent.terms_body.text: 请完整阅读条款。滚动到末尾后，下方的确认项才可勾选。

auth.consent.terms_body.text: 请完整阅读条款。滚动到末尾后，复选框才可勾选。

auth.consent.terms_link.text: 在新标签页中打开完整的服务条款

auth.consent.terms_scroll_hint.source: Scroll to the end of the terms to enable the confirmations.
auth.consent.terms_scroll_hint.text: 滚动到条款末尾即可勾选确认项。

auth.consent.terms_scroll_hint.text: 滚动到条款末尾即可勾选此复选框。

auth.forgot.subtitle.source: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password
auth.forgot.subtitle.text: 输入你的邮箱地址，我们会发送一个重置密码的链接

auth.forgot.success_body.source: If an account exists with this email, we've sent a password reset link. Please check your inbox.
auth.forgot.success_body.text: 如果该邮箱对应的账户存在，我们已发送密码重置链接，请查收邮件。

auth.login.resent_notice.source: A new verification email is on its way to {email}. Please check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.login.resent_notice.text: 新的验证邮件已发送至 {email}，请查收（也请检查垃圾邮件文件夹）。

auth.login.resent_toast.source: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.
auth.login.resent_toast.text: 验证邮件已发送，请查收。

auth.phone.bind_hint.source: Bind a mobile number to log in to this account with a verification code.
auth.phone.bind_hint.text: 绑定手机号后，可以用验证码登录此账户。

auth.phone.code_sent.source: If this phone number is eligible, a verification code has been sent.
auth.phone.code_sent.text: 如果该手机号符合条件，验证码已发送。

auth.phone.country_empty.text: 没有匹配的国家或地区。

auth.phone.national_hint.source: Select a country code, then enter your phone number.
auth.phone.national_hint.text: 先选择国家或地区代码，再输入手机号。

auth.phone.phone_hint.text: 选择国家或地区代码，或输入带 +国家代码 的完整号码。

auth.phone.phone_hint.source: Include the country code, such as +12025550123.

auth.phone.signup_pending.source: Account created successfully. Your registration is pending admin approval.
auth.phone.signup_pending.text: 账户创建成功，注册申请正在等待管理员审核。

auth.phone.signup_success.text: 账户创建成功，现在可以登录了。

auth.reset.new_password_hint.source: At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers
auth.reset.new_password_hint.text: 至少 8 个字符，包含大写字母、小写字母和数字

auth.reset.success_body.source: Your password has been reset successfully. You can now log in with your new password.
auth.reset.success_body.text: 密码已重置成功，现在可以用新密码登录。

auth.signup.details_body.source: Both questions are optional, but answers help admins approve accounts faster.
auth.signup.details_body.text: 两个问题都是选填，但回答有助于管理员更快审批账户。

auth.signup.discovery_hint.source: Optional, but helpful for improving outreach.
auth.signup.discovery_hint.text: 选填，可帮助我们改进推广。

auth.signup.discovery_label.text: 你是如何了解到我们的？

auth.signup.discovery_placeholder.source: Friend/classmate, search engine, social media, course link, etc.
auth.signup.discovery_placeholder.text: 朋友/同学、搜索引擎、社交媒体、课程链接等

auth.signup.fast_track.source: Open to {org} students — sign up with your @{domain} email for instant access. Everyone else: please describe your use case below — we review and approve manually.
auth.signup.fast_track.text: 向 {org} 的学生开放：使用 @{domain} 邮箱注册即可立即获得访问权限。其他用户请在下方描述你的用途，我们会人工审核。

auth.signup.password_hint.source: At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers.
auth.signup.password_hint.text: 至少 8 个字符，包含大写字母、小写字母和数字。

auth.signup.result_subtitle.source: Here is what happens with your account next.
auth.signup.result_subtitle.text: 以下是你的账户接下来的处理流程。

auth.signup.subtitle.source: Create an account to manage API keys and usage
auth.signup.subtitle.text: 创建账户以管理 API key 和用量

auth.signup.unavailable_body.source: This distribution does not currently accept public registrations.
auth.signup.unavailable_body.text: 本部署目前不开放公开注册。

auth.signup.use_case_hint.text: 有助于管理员更快完成审核。

auth.signup.use_case_placeholder.source: Tell us briefly what you plan to use the service for (research project, course, app prototype, etc.).
auth.signup.use_case_placeholder.text: 简要说明你打算如何使用本服务（研究项目、课程、应用原型等）。

auth.signup.username_hint.source: This name is shown in your account and admin review.
auth.signup.username_hint.text: 此名称会显示在你的账户和管理员审核页面中。

auth.validation.email_invalid.text: 请输入有效的邮箱地址

auth.validation.password_lower.text: 密码必须包含至少一个小写字母

auth.validation.password_upper.text: 密码必须包含至少一个大写字母

auth.validation.username_max.text: 用户名不能超过 50 个字符

auth.verify.already_body.source: Your email is already verified. You can log in to continue.
auth.verify.already_body.text: 你的邮箱已验证，可以直接登录。

auth.verify.already_message.source: Your email has already been verified. You can login now.
auth.verify.already_message.text: 你的邮箱已经验证过了，现在可以登录。

auth.verify.error_body.text: 我们无法验证你的邮箱。

auth.verify.loading_body.text: 正在验证你的邮箱地址，请稍候。

auth.verify.resend_prompt.text: 需要新的链接？输入邮箱，我们会重新发送验证邮件。

auth.verify.resent_notice.source: A new verification email is on its way to {email}. Please check your inbox (and spam folder), then follow the link to finish verifying.
auth.verify.resent_notice.text: 新的验证邮件已发送至 {email}。请查收（也请检查垃圾邮件文件夹），然后点击邮件中的链接完成验证。

auth.verify.resent_toast.source: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.
auth.verify.resent_toast.text: 验证邮件已发送，请查收。

auth.verify.success_body.source: Your account is now active. You can log in to continue.
auth.verify.success_body.text: 你的账户已激活，可以登录了。

auth.verify.try_another.text: 邮箱填错了？换一个试试
